intro: Mongolia is a vast, high, landlocked country of steppe, mountains and the Gobi Desert, squeezed between Russia and China.

chapters.title: Steppe and Gobi
text: Grassy steppe covers the centre, the Altai Mountains the west, and the Gobi Desert the south. Lake Khövsgöl in the north holds much of the country's fresh water.
Mongolia is the most sparsely populated country in the world.

chapters.title: Extreme climate
text: Winters drop below -40 °C, and Ulaanbaatar is the coldest capital in the world. Deadly winters called dzud can kill millions of animals.

keyTerms.meaning: A severe winter that kills livestock.
